title.zh: 所得税（经济与技术发展贷款利息及其他付款豁免）公告 2001
title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments for Economic and Technological Development Loans) Notification 2001

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments for Economic and Technological Development Loans) Notification 2001.
2. There shall be exempt from tax the interest payable under the junior subordinated notes by The Development Bank of Singapore Limited to DBS Capital Funding Corporation.
3. The exemption under paragraph 2 is subject to terms and conditions specified in the Monetary Authority of Singapore’s letter of approval dated 16th March 2001.
